names.AMP-shared-terrain-40k: AMP－分层 reset＋共享单判别器＋恢复均衡采样＋复杂地形高程 critic
names.SuperMimic-original-height-40k: SuperMimic－共享单判别器＋复杂地形＋原高度奖励
names.SuperMimic-half-height-40k: SuperMimic－共享单判别器＋复杂地形＋半强度高度奖励

timing_method: Training loop accumulators from iteration40000 logs; wall clock = process lstart to model_40000.pt mtime. AMP checkpoint iteration indexing includes 40001 rollouts vs SuperMimic40000 (one rollout,0.0025% difference). Timing includes shared-machine contention, not controlled exclusive-GPU benchmark. Setup, checkpoint/export/log overhead excluded from loop time but included in wall clock. GPUs RTX4090.
limitations: OOD stress test of existing easy-terrain-trained models, not newly trained hard-terrain models.
One training seed; eight joint-position jitters per terrain, fixed map and forward commands.
No resets/pushes/domain randomization; 2s stand +10s forward, 1 and2m/s; does not test commanded turning or induced recovery.
Sustained-fall counts are not course-completion success rates; speed and ground excursions also reported.
One central ground ray miss among4800samples in SuperMimic half-height20deg/15cm invertedstairs1m/s (0.02083%); remaining cases had no central ray misses.

suggested_hard_training_curriculum.note: Proposed only; no training configuration or running jobs changed in this evaluation.

results.name: AMP-shared-terrain-40k
results.protocol: Nominal controlled-column terrain seed12345, fixed difficulty0.5 (evaluation-only layout), 8 standing starts per type, 2s stand then 10s specified vx; five rows to keep 2m/s trials inside terrain, no resets/push/DR; final5s torso yaw-frame errors; first trial of every type recorded, no selection by outcome.
results.fall_definition: root ground-relative height<0.5m OR gz>-0.342, continuously >=0.5s; sampled at50Hz
